title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines' live records start at different dates: v005 counts from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, a losing start is expected rather than a surprise, and the average winner was roughly +19%. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-12T15:00:44.045Z.

## Paper only, and 1 trade is not proof
Every position here is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. 1 trade says nothing about a strategy. The record is a running state of the engines, not a verdict on them. It shows what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. A result cannot establish an edge, and a losing run cannot refute one. The record updates continuously, so any snapshot is a moment in time rather than a conclusion. The framing comes first because the numbers only describe paper activity.

## Open positions and the most recent closed trades
- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper; 4 closed trades so far; average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005: 0 positions open on paper; 6 closed trades so far; average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006: 0 positions open on paper; 7 closed trades so far; average -13.34% net per trade.
The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 remains open, so it has no closed result in this snapshot. The ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close closed at 1.703 on 18 October 2026, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. Taken together, the engines show no open positions in the records above, while the closed-trade averages are negative for the trend engines and null for htf-rsi-v007. Those are measurements, not interpretations.

## What the market filter is allowing
trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. With the filter off, both trend engines show 0 positions open on paper. The closest names to their 20-day breakout are AVAXUSDT at 6.73% below its high, TRXUSDT at 10.05% below its high, and BNBUSDT at 10.54% below its high. Those distances are the measured gaps in the record. They describe how far each name is from its 20-day breakout level, not whether an entry will occur. The filter state and the engine rules govern entries. No advice or prediction follows from these levels, and no coin is recommended by its distance alone.

## Where to check the same numbers
The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, so the engines' own state remains the source for what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-12T15:00:44.045Z. If a number changes, the page, the log, and the channel status should reflect it. Readers can compare those three places against this article without needing any extra calculation.
